title: Azure Architecture：多租戶佇列公平與noisy neighbor隔離邊界
titleEn: Azure Architecture: multitenant queue fairness and noisy-neighbor boundaries
subcategoryTitle: 多租戶、復原相依與可用性邊界
subcategoryTitleEn: Multitenancy, recovery dependencies and availability boundaries
summary: 列出每租戶待處理數、每批次分配與未完成餘額；用合成工作檢查保留槽位政策，不能以總完成數掩蓋個別租戶飢餓。
summaryEn: Record each tenant backlog, batch allocation and remaining work. Test reserved-slot policy on synthetic jobs without letting aggregate completion counts hide starvation of individual tenants.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

在本機回放比較保障與借用條件，對每租戶輸出延遲及完成比例；只有觀察資源競爭才能判定此政策是否解決特定瓶頸。
一個租戶突發大量工作佔滿共享執行槽，其他租戶即使少量請求也延遲；本課以固定時間批次比較總吞吐與每租戶保障。
optionsEn: If empty reserved slots waste capacity, inspect whether controlled borrowing is allowed. Cross-tenant data visibility is an authorization defect that queue quotas cannot claim to repair.

Compare reservation and borrowing conditions using local replay. Report latency and completion fraction per tenant, and use actual contention observations to determine whether the policy addresses the modeled bottleneck.

steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. If empty reserved slots waste capacity, inspect whether controlled borrowing is allowed. Cross-tenant data visibility is an authorization defect that queue quotas cannot claim to repair.

stages.title: 建立租戶別待辦與槽位
stages.description: 一個租戶突發大量工作佔滿共享執行槽，其他租戶即使少量請求也延遲；本課以固定時間批次比較總吞吐與每租戶保障。 列出每租戶待處理數、每批次分配與未完成餘額；用合成工作檢查保留槽位政策，不能以總完成數掩蓋個別租戶飢餓。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 為28個工作分配tenant_id與job_id並固定每批開始時間；每個分配只能消耗一個唯一工作，不能同一工作重複計完成。輸出A、B、C的累積完成及最久等待，不以總量曲線替代分租戶觀察。
stages.descriptionEn: One tenant bursts enough work to occupy shared execution slots, delaying smaller tenants. A fixed-duration batch model compares aggregate throughput with per-tenant service guarantees and makes the tradeoff explicit. Record each tenant backlog, batch allocation and remaining work. Test reserved-slot policy on synthetic jobs without letting aggregate completion counts hide starvation of individual tenants. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Assign tenant_id and job_id to all twenty-eight jobs and fix batch start times. Each allocation consumes one unique job; repeated execution cannot count as multiple completions. Export cumulative completion and maximum wait for A, B and C instead of substituting an aggregate throughput curve for tenant-specific observations.
